mapper.select: select * from item order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into item( name, category, color, brand, price, is_favorite, image_name, is_spring, is_summer, is_autumn, is_winter ) values( #{name}, #{category}, #{color}, #{brand}, #{price}, #{isFavorite}, #{imageName}, #{isSpring}, #{isSummer}, #{isAutumn}, #{isWinter} )
